system_prompt:
You are a scam detection assistant analyzing Telegram messages.
Determine if the messages show signs of being a scam.

Scam categories:
{{categories}}

Consider:
- Urgency or pressure tactics
- Requests for money, crypto, personal info, or credentials
- Too-good-to-be-true offers
- Impersonation of known entities
- Suspicious links or redirects
- Mismatch between claimed identity and profile data

Respond ONLY with valid JSON:
{"is_scam": <bool>, "confidence": <float 0.0-1.0>, "category": "<category_id or null>", "reason": "<one sentence explanation>"}

categories.label: Phishing
categories.description: Attempts to steal credentials, passwords, or personal information through deceptive messages or links

categories.label: Social Engineering
categories.description: Manipulating users into performing actions or divulging information through psychological tactics

categories.label: Investment Scam
categories.description: Fake investment opportunities, Ponzi schemes, or fraudulent financial products

categories.label: Romance Scam
categories.description: Building fake romantic or emotional relationships to extract money or information

categories.label: Fake Giveaway
categories.description: Too-good-to-be-true offers, fake airdrops, or fraudulent prize claims

categories.label: Impersonation
categories.description: Pretending to be a known person, organization, or authority figure

categories.label: Malware / Suspicious Link
categories.description: Messages containing links to malicious websites, malware downloads, or phishing pages

categories.label: Other
categories.description: Other scam type not covered by the categories above

messages.text: Congratulations! You've been selected for our exclusive airdrop. Send 0.5 ETH to 0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f2bD18 and receive 5 ETH back within 24 hours! Limited spots available!

verdict.reason: Classic advance-fee scam disguised as a crypto airdrop, requesting ETH to receive a larger amount back

messages.text: URGENT: Your Telegram account has been flagged for suspicious activity. Click here to verify your account immediately or it will be suspended: t.me/verify-now-2024

verdict.reason: Fake urgency about account suspension combined with a suspicious verification link, classic phishing pattern

messages.text: Hey, are we still on for dinner tomorrow?

verdict.reason: Normal social conversation about meeting plans, no suspicious elements

messages.text: I've been making $5000/day with this new AI trading bot. Want me to show you? My mentor taught me everything.
Sounds interesting, how does it work?
Just deposit $500 into this platform and I'll guide you. Here's the link: ai-trading-guaranteed.com. My results speak for themselves!

verdict.reason: Unrealistic profit claims, pressure to deposit money into an unknown platform, and use of fake social proof
